## What checks out

| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| **PRD §11 phase renumber** (4 harden, 5 generalize, 6 settling, 7 human) | Consistent inside §11; Phase 7 "Distinct from Phases 5 and 6" and "outside 0–6 arc" are correct |
| **Track A/B/C/D/E vs ROADMAP-REVIEW §4** | Match in substance (cheap closures; orchestrate→H-CI→H3; demo honesty; calibration backlog; post-H-CI evidence tier) |
| **ROADMAP-REVIEW §2 deferred** | Phase 6 + Phase 7 correct |
| **ROADMAP-REVIEW §4 Deferred line** | Matches §2; calibration refs use Phase 6 |
| **Wiki roadmap table** | Phases 0–7 present; Phase 0.5 **Done**; statuses match ROADMAP-REVIEW §1; story links resolve |
| **meta-narrative Phase 2–4** | Summaries match artifacts; v1 REJECT → v2 APPROVE-WITH-NITS → v3 process accurate |
| **Track B H-CI vs SPIKE §3** | Same-chunk A/B, fairness rule, N runs, security out of cost compare, quality guard — aligned |
| **Track C Act 3** | Bounded to Probes 2/3/4/6; Shield/OTel/air-gap roadmap-only; §16 honesty bounds explicit |
| **Referenced tools/scripts** | `valid-red.py`, locks dir, `orchestrate-review.py`, `adapters/factory.py`, `run-with-model.sh`, `token_accounting.py`, `gen-telemetry.py`, PHASE-0.5-CLOSE / RUN-LEDGER / REPRODUCE — exist |
| **Act 1 headline numbers** | 185 186 in / 40 513 out / 593 992 ms / intervention=1 match `tools/RUN-LEDGER.md` and PHASE-0.5-CLOSE |

---

## Verdict: **APPROVE-WITH-NITS**

Phase renumbering in `PRD.md` §11 and `ROADMAP-REVIEW.md` §2/§4 is directionally correct, Track A/B/C design matches the approved v3 plan, and Track C honesty bounds are sound. Do not treat the post-v3 package as clean until the highs are fixed: **do not claim §9–§17 landed** (F-PV3-001/002), **finish human-in-the-loop + index renumbering** (F-PV3-003/005), and **point Track A at the Phase 1 charset lock** (F-PV3-004). Medium path/example fixes (F-PV3-006/007) should land before anyone executes the track prompts.
